description:
Search companies on Remoet, or list the user's starred companies (starred: true). Returns a summary per result. Full detail (description, perks, URLs) is on get_listing, by slug. Job boards and aggregators are excluded; talent networks that post direct roles (e.g. Toptal) appear as companies.

CRITICAL, star quality: only star companies whose tech stack OVERLAPS the user's skills (a JavaScript dev should not star a Go/Rust-only shop). Stars are the user's job-feed noise filter, so an irrelevant star pollutes their feed with jobs they can't use. Judge overlap by each result's matchedTechStack: the technologies from your techStack filter that the company actually uses, checked against its FULL stack (not the capped preview), so do NOT skip a company just because the visible preview omits the user's skills. An empty matchedTechStack means the result matched on text, not tags. techStackCount is the company's true tag total; the full stack unlocks on starring. techStack matches AT LEAST ONE filtered technology by default; set techStackMatch:"all" to require every one.

starred: true limits results to the user's starred companies; combined with techStack it returns matchedTechStack per starred company, which shows any star with zero overlap.

Example: search_listings({ searchQuery: "payments", techStack: ["TypeScript", "React"], experienceLevel: ["mid"] }).

experienceLevel.description: Only companies with at least one open role at any of these seniorities (e.g. ["junior"] for entry-level-friendly companies). Each result's experienceLevels field shows its per-seniority role counts; a 0 can also mean seniority was not detected for those roles.

searchQuery.description: Search keyword: matches company name, description, and about text

sortBy.description: Sort results by: stars (most popular), jobCount (most active hiring), or name (alphabetical). Default: relevance when searching/filtering, stars when browsing

starred.description: Set true to list the user's STARRED companies instead of searching the full catalog. In this mode searchQuery/experienceLevel/sort/pagination are ignored; pass techStack to get a matchedTechStack per starred company for auditing stack fit.

techStack.description: Filter by technologies (e.g. ["React", "Node.js", "TypeScript"]). Each result's matchedTechStack shows which matched. Technologies are auto-normalized.

techStackMatch.description: How techStack combines: "any" (default, at least one technology) or "all" (every technology required; use for must-have stacks)

name: search_listings
title: Search Companies
